sentences.text: The report period for wellbore 15/9-F-14 runs from 2007-12-05, the first report not flagged as dated before spud, to 2016-10-19, the last report.
The report span is 3241.96 days with 121 active days across 134 reports, of which 13 reports are flagged as dated before spud.
The reports form 7 campaigns, from the 2007 drilling campaign to the 2016 plug and abandonment campaign.
Total depth is 3750 m measured depth (Sodir total depth), and the deepest reported true vertical depth is 3158.5 m.
Total activity time is 2945.75 hours, of which primary lost time is 248.5 hours, 8.44% of activity time.

The main drilling outcome was the 8.5 in final section, which reached the total depth; the main operational losses came from the 36 in section repairs, riser and wireline equipment failures, and the 2016 lost circulation and fish retrieval during plug and abandonment.

Sodir lists the purpose as production, the status as P&A, and the completion date, meaning the end of drilling, as 2008-06-17; the reports continue after that date because of workovers and plug and abandonment, so the last report date is later than completion.

claims.value: Cut 14" casing at 878m

sentences.text: On 2016-09-14 the 14 in casing was cut at the planned depth, as the report records: "Cut 14" casing at 878m", and the cutting run took 0.25 hours of primary lost time.

Before running the 26 in drilling BHA, the next well on this field should verify the fastening of downhole survey tool sleeves and clear the template of loose items, because the UBHO sleeve fault on 2007-12-05 and the claw lost on 2007-12-04 caused BHA pulls.

Section 3 repairs and the 2007-12-05 bit junk show that the 26 in bit and survey sub need inspection before running; in section 1 the 36 in repairs accounted for 40.02% of section time, so the next well should plan spare parts and a verified tool check for the 36 in section.

Test riser and tensioner systems, including the nitrogen fill, before running the riser: the 2008-04-29 tension system fault cost 3.0 hours of primary time, and a planned five-yearly tension cylinder job on 2009-03-12 stopped wireline work for 80.0 hours of possible time.

Wireline tools should be power-checked and the tractor oil level verified before perforating runs: the 2008-07-04 power failure cost 6.0 hours of primary time and the 2008-07-03 toolcatcher stick needs a pre-job check of the toolstring.

Plan plug-and-abandonment logistics around weather: the 2010-09-16 wait on plug equipment from shore cost 50.25 hours of primary time, so the next well should stage equipment on site before the campaign.

For plug and abandonment through a fractured or losing interval, prepare lost circulation material and a clear diverter release plan before pulling the diverter: losses of 10.5 m3 per hour on 2016-08-12 led to 12.75 hours of primary lost circulation time, and the diverter took 1.5 hours to free on 2016-08-14.

Record hole size and casing size for the later sections: hole sizes for sections 8 to 22 are not reported, so drilling rates cannot be stated for them and the next well should log them in the daily reports.

row.comments: Held toolbox talk prior to making up 26" drilling BHA. Removed masterbushing and ran 26" Bit / gMWD assy through rotary. Inserted gMWD probe in BHA as per Scientific instructions. Meanwhile ROV attempted to connect hose to CTS funnel. CTS hose was too short and the funnel had to be turned. ROV lost 3-finger claw when attempteing to turn CTS funnel.
Checked UBHO relative to scribeline. Checked and thightened UBHO sleeve. Inspected 26" bit at Centralizer deck - no wear observed.
Made up and RIH with 26" drilling BHA from 63 m to 196 m MD. Stabbed into CTS funnel while observing with ROV.
Washed down with 26" drilling BHA from 196 m to 209 m MD pumping at 2000 lpm.

POOH with 26" junk removal BHA from 206 m MD to surface on 5 1/2" HWDP. Laid down 1 x 8 1/4" DC. Racked back jar/DC assy. Lifted UBHO/MWD assy to HTS due to wind speed limitations on crane. Pulled 9 3/4" DC/bit stand to surface and inspected 26" rock bit. Found 2 x pieces of junk trapped in roller cones. Removed 1 piece of 800 g. The other piece was jammed in middle of the bit and could not be removed easily. Also found several worn teeth on bit.

Established drilling parameters. Drilled 26" hole section from 206 m to 211 m MD. Drilling parameters : Flow 3100 lpm / SPP 62 bar / 1-2 MT WOB / Rotation 125 RPM / String torque 1-3 kNm. Pumped 20 m3 hi-vis to clean the hole at 211 m MD. Scientifc drilling reported that UBHO sleeve had not been fastened correctly in the carrier. Decided to pull BHA for remedial action.
POOH with 26" drilling BHA from 211 m MD to 63 m MD. No drag observed when pulling BHA through conductor shoe. Racked back DC/jar and NMDC stands to access UBHO sub.
Held pre-job meeting prior to running 20" csg. PU 20" shoe joint. Encountered signal problems to casing tong.

Established circulation in steps with SW to 2300 lpm. At 2000 lpm / 65 bar the returns broke through on well F-12. Reduced flow to 200 lpm / 27 bar and observed for 15 min. Continued circulating 320 m3 of SW at 2300 lpm with returns on F-12. Kept landing string in tension by an overpull of 3 MT.
Installed hatch cover on F-13 & F-15. Found that tension system not filled with Nitrogen.

Held tool box talk and ran in with the HPDR lifting sub and made up same. Released hydraulic pressure to the tension cylinders and kept 132 MT on the string. Filled damper tank with Nitrogen. Applied 90 bars hydraulic pressure to the tension cylinders = 150 MT. Disconnected the HPDR lifting sub and retrieved same to rig floor.
Trouble shooted the PDM, found that PDM had to be re-programmed for handling HWDP.
POOH and laid out 3 jnt incompatible tool jnts. Picked up and meassured 3 new jnts.
Stopped displacement. SIDPP 136 bar. Discussed situation and way forward.

Found leakage across fittings for DHSV. Made several attempts to fix fitting with locktite - negative. Took out DHSV control line. Removed fittings and installed new ones. Applied lock tite to fitting threads.
Worked to free WL toolstring from toolcatcher.

Continiued to trouble shoot power problem with toolstring. Had same problem with tools at surface. Found lower part of Welltec tractor drained for hydraulic oil. This may have affected tools below because the power situation in the toolstring was altered.
Waiting on MDN. Unable to proceed with WL operation due to ongoing 5-yearly work on tension cylinders in moonpool.
Troubleshot winch problem, Mærsk electrician assisted. Bypassed relay, restarted power pack and let it run for two hours without any problem. Decided to continue acc. to program.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Boat departure cancelled due to poor weather forecast. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment due to loose strand on 7/16" cable.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment.

Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment. Rigged up lubricator with grease inj. head. Function tested tractor through cable. Held SJA meeting regarding RD of wireline equipment and skidding preparations.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well. Held SJA meeting regarding RD wireline equipment and prepare for skidding.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well. Held pre-job meeting with involved personnel.

Re-attempted to pressure up A-annulus to 50 bar from cement unit.
Pumped 18ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar. No indication of ASV opening.
Performed new line-up test and checked all valves.

Attempted to increase A-annulus pressure in stages of 10 bar to 120 bar with control line pressure of 480 bar. No indications of ASV opening. Pressure leaked off 1,5 bar/min. Bled off pressure.
Volume pumped to 120 bar, 23ltrs. Bled back same.

Pressured up A-annulus to 120 bar, then applied 480 bar pressure on control line. No indication of ASV opening. Pressure leaked off 1,5bar/min. Bled off control line and A-annulus.
Volume pumped 23 ltrs. Bled back same.

Performed line-up test to 120 bar, opened lo-torque valve. No pressure drop seen when opening lo-torque.
Checked all valves and hoses. R/D hose on A-annulus wing and observed cement residues coming out from hose.
Replaced hose.

Pressured up ASV control line to 420 bar. Pressured up A-annulus from cement unit to 50 bar. Pumped 136 ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar (expected volume to pump 82 ltrs). Possible air/gas.
Bled off pressure through mud-gas separator.
Pressured up A-annulus again to 50 bar while applying 420 bar on ASV control line. Pumped 129 ltrs from 10 bar to 50 bar. Bled down pressure through mud-gas separator.

Pulled free of fish, hung up with grapple at 139.4m through hanger. Troubleshoot to get through. 
Attempted to pull with max 10 ton overpull - no success. 
Pulled up slowly and rotate to the right - no success. Tried to rotate to the left and pull - no success.  
Pulled and pumped with 200l/min - 4 bar, pressure increased to 30bar when took weight at 139.4m. 
RIH and engaged spear inside 10 3/4in csg, pulled same through the hanger - ok. 
Rotated it 4.5 turns to the left (2-3k torq) to reposition casing fish inside the well. Landed fish in the well and released spear. 
Attempted to pull spear through hanger - no success. Pulled up total of 3,4m from top of csg stump at 141.9m
Released fish. Pulled gradually to 170t weight on hook (65t overpull). Observed drop on hook load to 103t indicating string free.
Flow checked well on trip tank. Well not static. Losses of 10,5m3/hour

Attempted to pull diverter w/ max 15t overpull. Lifted BOP and observed slick joint loosened in overshot. Cleaned around hold down dogs and observed one dog slightly engaged. Wedged in hold down dog and pulled diverter up passed dogs. Max overpull 12 Ton

WOC
Meanwhile:
- Serviced drilling equipment and prepared fishing tools
- Removed masterbushing and inspected diverter and BOP for lost centralizer piece. No findings.
- Performed periodic maintenace on drilling equipment

Positioned cutter at 878m.
Cut 14" casing at 878m, 450 lpm / 43 bar. Observed pressure drop in SPP, good indication of cut.
Pulled up 1m with flow, observed pressure increased. RIH slowly and measured 10 cm window.
